recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: pocket OLED screens getting sharper in miniature
vegemite philosophy threads drifting through the feed
AI labs drafting caution labels on the eve of going public
autumn overcast settling low over San Francisco
agents spun up from a phone before the fog lifts

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Swipe between fog lanes over a muted bay skyline and tap when a gap opens to let sunrise light through before overcast closes it.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: lane switch + timing tap through moving fog gaps
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right to change lane, tap to burst through a gap
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each cleared gap leaks warm amber color; chaining five reveals a brief shipping-by-sunrise flash across the horizon.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog rolls faster, lanes narrow, decoy gaps appear that punish mistimed taps.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor grays with sudden gold leaks, soft autumn SF silhouette

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Four agent proposals drift side-by-side on screen — drag the one clean diff into the center merge slot before the others collide into a conflict blob.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: sort/compare — pick the winning path from parallel drifting cards
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag one card into the center slot
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Snapping the right proposal into place feels like a surgical lock-in after watching four brains spin up.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: More proposals spawn, trap cards mimic valid diffs, merge window shrinks each round.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: split-pane terminal wireframe, charcoal background with green syntax highlights

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick glowing pixel clusters across a tiny OLED grid to assemble one perfect 8×8 icon before the screen auto-dims.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: flick clusters with momentum; release near a slot to snap
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Completing one crisp icon triggers a satisfying lock-in pulse — one icon, one round, done.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Grid shrinks, wrong snaps drain brightness, screen dims faster each attempt.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: pure OLED black with single-hue neon pixels, impossibly sharp mini display

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to spread vegemite across rotating toast slices — release at the golden coverage ratio before the batch timer expires.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: hold/release pressure spread with coverage target
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: hold finger to spread, release when the meter hits the sweet spot
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Hitting exactly 87% coverage makes the toast sigh and the round ends on a perfect spread.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Bread rotates mid-spread, crust zones reject paste, order queue stacks faster.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: flat breakfast illustration, bold ochre toast and deep brown spread
